description: List all sales channels (Holded API v2). Cursor-paginated: pass the previous response nextCursor as cursor. Response fields are snake_case; amounts are strings with decimal comma. Supports field filtering to reduce response size.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response nextCursor

fields.description: Project only these fields per item (e.g. ["id", "name"]). Reduces response size.

limit.description: Max items per page (server-paginated; use limit to control page size)

summary.description: Return only count and pagination metadata without items (default: false)

name: list_sales_channels
